name: QA Testing
description: Author, run, and maintain browser test suites recorded in sheets.
examples: Test my login page — the creds are in env as LOGIN_EMAIL and LOGIN_PASSWORD
Run the checkout regression suite against staging
Create a test case for the signup flow
What failed in last night's test run?
Re-run the failed tests from this morning
long_description: QA Testing turns an agent into a proactive QA engineer. It keeps a test registry in a channel-scoped sheet (test cases, runs, results), executes cases through deterministic browser replay so green runs cost almost nothing, heals broken locators without ever healing assertions, and reports failures with transcripts and screenshots. Works with the Browser and Drive runtime capabilities and the Sheets plugin.
